It seems like a distraction. אלא אדרבה, כוונות פירוש המילות על פי הקבלה מסייעים לחזק את עומק השגת הכלל באחדות אלוקות, כי ידוע ליודע ולטועם טעם בהם דרך פרט וכו'. On the contrary, if a person knows how to do it properly, then start see having these particular כוונות in דאווענינג according to קבלה, like according to האריז"ל, actually strengthens their ability to really understand the general appreciation of Godliness, as it's known to anybody that has tasted them of studying it in a detailed way. רק החדשים, but for somebody that's new to this whole study, so when a person's at a, you know, beginner, יתר טוב להם להעמיק דרך כלל תחילה, a person should first focus on the general and think about these general כוונות, עד שיורגלו מעט מעט בדרך הפרט דווקא ודי למבין, and they should slowly become accustomed to seeing how that general idea is found and expressed in the details, like we did, like the Rebbe walked us through in in that קונטרס ענינה של תורת החסידות, where he first helped us, you know, break out of our concept of the details and see that there's this general essence that is higher than it and transcends it, and then brought us back down to see how that general essence is being expressed in all of these פרטים. And so that's the proper approach is to first make sure that a person has a very strong, even though it's somewhat abstract appreciation of that general point, and then when they see how that general point is applied and expressed in the details, then they're going to start to get a really rich, deep personal understanding of that כלל in a way that it's all connected to that כלל and it's not a distraction. And so that's the process, and that's, you know, the idea of like learning all this, which is why also he's going to start from the top, and like and האריז"ל also starts from the top, talking about God's essence that transcends everything, the essence of the infinite light before the צמצום, and that's the כלל, and then we want to see this process we're going to see how that comes down and permeates all the details. But then eventually, after doing that from the top down, then actually mostly the המשכים are really from the bottom up and then back, back down again. So we'll see. But okay. So, yeah, to recap, that's just the basic approach is that we need to make sure that we always keep the big picture in mind that it's, you know, there's only God and all these levels we're learning about and talking about are all just Him choosing to express Himself and there's really nothing separate from Him and it's all just an expression of that essence. And with that in mind, then we can learn about all these details and hopefully see how they connect back to that and are really an expression of that. That's the point that always has to be our objective and not to just think that we're trying to like make this list of learning about all these levels and make maps of them and memorize all these names and all these ideas and משלים and whatever which could become very distracting from from the point. You know, there's like a story like that. They say that you know, it says in the גמרא that somebody says that that I דאווען, אני מתפלל על דעת זה התינוק, I דאווען with the כוונה of like a little kid. That you know, he would just had like a simple faith, like I'm standing in front of, you know, a little kid imagines that God is like this invisible king that is standing in front of him and he can ask him for whatever he wants and he'll help him and you know, so he דאווענס like that kind of that simple type of אמונה. And it says that when a little kid is imagining God like that, it's so close to the truth you can call it the truth, because even though in a certain way he's like, you know, humanizing God and imagining Him, but he's not limiting God by using that imagery because he really is recognizes that God is infinite and is, you know, could do whatever He wants and He's beyond anything. So even though he imagines Him in this very simple physical way, but it's so close to the truth you can call it the truth. On the other hand, you could have somebody that's sitting and he's דאווענינג and he's thinking about אדם קדמון and the highest level סדר השתלשלות, but he's under, he thinks that that he's, you know, got God figured out and it's limiting, and he's really limiting God to this intellectual, even though it's a very high, philosophical, whatever, a lofty intellectual idea, but he's limiting God by that form, and he says that that that's that's so close to עבודה זרה, you can actually call it עבודה זרה. So this is what we're what we're trying to watch out for, that we're going to be learning about all this stuff, you know, in the סדר השתלשלות and קבלה things and חסידות and all this stuff, but we have to, you know, the whole idea is to see how that keep in mind that essence, that יחידה, and how everything is expressing that, and not let that יחידה get trapped in any of these לבושים. Instead we want to see how it's that those are actually expressing that יחידה. That's the idea.
